title: Read a grid cell
summary: MATLAB: Read a grid cell. Read row 1, column 2.
introduction: Semicolons divide matrix rows. A cell is selected by row, then column.
learningObjectives: Read a grid cell with MATLAB

blocks.text: Use MATLAB. Paste one example into the Command Window, or save it as a .m script and run the script. A MATLAB licence may be required.
The semicolon starts a new matrix row. (2,1) selects its first value, 3.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Write row before column in the index.
